text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rumble rumble rumble!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhh!! I'm gonna, 
wiiiiiiiiinnnnnnn!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH, DON'T UNDERESTIMATE THE 
OVERLORD!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Neither side is backing down an inch! A 
fierce battle! An all-out clash! The 
winner is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto! Surpassing the era's 
centerpiece, the glorious Overlord, she 
surges forward in a monumental, raging 
charge!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, wheeze*...!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: This is Doto...? This... power is...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: What was... that feeling just now...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: What is... this feeling...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fluffy... sparkly... and on top of that, 
I'm so, so, so happy!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Is this... me when I'm serious? If I can 
do my best like this, surely...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I know I can become it! A truly dazzling 
version of myself!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Kuh-kuh-kuh, bwahaha! This impatience, 
this sense of fulfillment...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Doto. This defeat has shown me 
that my legend still has far more yet to 
come.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Let us grow even stronger and aim for the 
throne above the clouds! To become the 
Super Ultra Miracle Supreme Overlord who 
surpasses both you and the previous 
generation!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hai-ee, I'll follow you, Opera O-san. 
Wait, that's not it...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I will do my best! As rivals who push each 
other to greater heights!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What on earth is this...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"The variance in lap time is impossible! 
She slightly surpassed... the theoretical 
absolute value!?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
A person's capacity... isn't supposed to 
change. But that guy, those guys, they 
went and smashed right through the ceiling 
that I could never break!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Man, it's too close to call. The previous 
gen's raw numbers are still higher, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The Three Goddesses... rolled the damn 
dice!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Grass-chan. Looks like the Arima Kinen is 
gonna get interesting!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan... After seeing that race just 
now... can you... really say that?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm getting even more thrilled than 
before. Both Doto and Opera O have gotten 
stronger. Does this mean—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It feels great, doesn't it! If we all get 
hyped up together, I feel like there's no 
limit to how awesome we can be!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—That's true. You're right. I'm sorry, 
that was very unlike me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I cannot stand here shivering with dread. 
I must meet it head-on—with dignity.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer-saaaan! Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. I... I...!
choice_data_list: You're just one step away from your dream

You're just one step away from your dream, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Next time... next time I definitely 
want to run in the Arima Kinen! On that 
grand stage...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I will become a sparkling Umamusume! I'll 
beat the generation above me and Opera 
O-san... to become the sparkliest of them 
all...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto unlocked the door of 
possibility, breaking free of her 
dependence on TM Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next up is—the decisive battle at the 
Arima Kinen. To seize the brilliance she 
dreamed of, she must defeat every single 
Umamusume!
